applicabilityBasis.summary: thUSD is marketed and used as a 1:1 USD-pegged stablecoin for payments and transfers, minted and redeemed against USDC/USDT, which places it in the GENIUS payment-stablecoin perimeter even though yield is distributed through the separate sthUSD staking wrapper rather than on the token itself.

genius.notes: Theo Protocol Corporation is a Panama-registered company operating from New York. Its terms state the company, platform, and services are not registered or licensed by any governmental or regulatory authority, and no OCC, Federal Reserve, or state payment-stablecoin application for Theo appears in regulator directories reviewed on 2026-09-29. As a foreign issuer with no US authorization and no foreign-exception registration evidence, the pathway and foreign-exception posture stay unknown. The transparency dashboard publishes real-time reserve data with a self protocol attestation and custodian attestations, but no monthly independent reserve attestation of the aggregate exists yet (an independent auditor is listed as in progress).
